by

  exact ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.IsReversible.invariant (fun A B hA hB => h A B hA hB)
target_source: ∀ (α : Type*) [MeasurableSpace α] (κ : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel α α) [ProbabilityTheory.IsMarkovKernel κ] (π : MeasureTheory.Measure α), (∀ A B : Set α, MeasurableSet A → MeasurableSet B → ∫⁻ x in A, κ x B ∂π = ∫⁻ x in B, κ x A ∂π) → π.bind κ = π
